name: Bill Randolph
biography: Bill Randolph was born on October 11, 1953 in Detroit, Michigan, USA. He is known for his work on Friday the 13th Part 2 (1981), Dressed to Kill (1980) and Double Negative (1985).
movies: His Name Was Jason: 30 Years of Friday the 13th
Crystal Lake Memories: The Complete History of Friday the 13th
